Simona Waltert (born 13 December 2000) is a Swiss professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 88, achieved on 20 October 2025, and a doubles ranking of No. 88, achieved on 27 October 2025. To date, she has won one doubles title on the WTA Tour , one singles and five WTA 125 doubles titles. Career [ edit ] 2017: Juniors [ edit ] Waltert was a girls' singles semifinalist at the 2017 Wimbledon Championships , losing to eventual runner-up Ann Li . On the ITF Junior Circuit , Waltert had a career-high combined ranking of No. 9, achieved on 22 January 2018. [ 1 ] 2019-2023: WTA Tour and major debuts, maiden doubles title [ edit ] Waltert made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2019 Ladies Open Lausanne , where she received a wildcard for the singles and doubles tournaments. [ 2 ] She won her first WTA Tour doubles title at the 2021 Ladies Open Lausanne , partnering Susan Bandecchi . [ 3 ] Waltert at the 2022 French Open At the 2022 Ladies Open Lausanne , she earned her first top-10 win as a wildcard over world No. 7 and top seed Danielle Collins , saving three match points in the deciding tiebreak.
